corpus.format: utf-8 TSV: id, title, body, tenant; LF terminated

bm25f.combination: sum(field_weight * normalized_field_tf), then one BM25 saturation per term

analysis.external_weighted_field: title tokens repeated exactly 3 times followed by body tokens; frozen corpus keeps title/body lengths equal per document so this is algebraically identical to the pinned BM25F field normalization

environment.filesystem_identity_policy: runner output, corpus, index, and result artifact must have the same decimal POSIX st_dev identity
environment.memory_limit_policy: inherit one detected host address-space limit; adapters do not raise or lower it
environment.resource_scope: single adapter process per retained repetition
environment.peak_rss_metric: process lifetime peak resident bytes when the runtime exposes it; otherwise typed unsupported

execution.tie_break: score descending, UTF-8 document ID ascending
execution.cache_state: warm in-process index; every retained repetition rebuilds, checkpoints, closes, and reopens its own index

ranking_evidence.title_weight: doc-000006 title tf=1/length=4 ranks above doc-000007 body tf=2/length=4 at 3:1, and below it at 1:1
ranking_evidence.term_frequency: doc-000000 ranks above doc-000001 at equal field lengths because body tf=4 ranks above body tf=1
ranking_evidence.length_normalization: doc-000009 body tf=1/length=4 ranks above doc-000008 body tf=1/length=12; disabling b reverses them by the document-ID tie-break
